description: This file provides an interface class 'AdbInterface' for communicating with an Android device via the adb command-line tool. It includes methods to send commands, execute shell commands, manage device targets, install apps, push/pull files, start instrumentation tests, wait for device states, and perform runtime resets.

classes.name: AdbInterface
classes.description: A helper class encapsulating communication with an Android device through adb commands, supporting device targeting, command execution, file management, instrumentation, and device state management.

methods.name: SetEmulatorTarget(self)
methods.description: Configures subsequent commands to target the only running emulator.

methods.name: SetDeviceTarget(self)
methods.description: Configures subsequent commands to target the only connected USB device.

methods.name: SetTargetSerial(self, serial)
methods.description: Sets the target device serial number for subsequent commands.

methods.name: SendCommand(self, command_string, timeout_time=60, retry_count=3)
methods.description: Sends an adb command, with optional timeout and retries, and returns the output.

methods.name: SendShellCommand(self, cmd, timeout_time=20, retry_count=3)
methods.description: Executes an adb shell command and returns its output.

methods.name: BugReport(self, path)
methods.description: Collects a bug report from the device and saves it to the specified path.

methods.name: Push(self, src, dest)
methods.description: Pushes a file from host to device.

methods.name: Pull(self, src, dest)
methods.description: Pulls a file from device to host.

methods.name: Install(self, apk_path, extra_flags)
methods.description: Installs an APK onto the device.

methods.name: DoesFileExist(self, src)
methods.description: Checks if a file exists on the device.

methods.name: EnableAdbRoot(self)
methods.description: Attempts to restart adb as root on the device.

methods.name: StartInstrumentationForPackage( self, package_name, runner_name, timeout_time=60*10, no_window_animation=False, instrumentation_args={}, user=None, no_hidden_api_checks=False)
methods.description: Runs instrumentation tests for a specified package and runner.

methods.name: StartInstrumentation( self, instrumentation_path, timeout_time=60*10, no_window_animation=False, profile=False, instrumentation_args={}, user=None, no_hidden_api_checks=False)
methods.description: Starts an instrumentation test and returns test results and bundle.

methods.name: StartInstrumentationNoResults( self, package_name, runner_name, no_window_animation=False, raw_mode=False, instrumentation_args={}, user=None, no_hidden_api_checks=False)
methods.description: Runs instrumentation and dumps output to stdout without parsing results.

methods.name: PreviewInstrumentationCommand( self, package_name, runner_name, no_window_animation=False, raw_mode=False, instrumentation_args={}, user=None, no_hidden_api_checks=False)
methods.description: Returns the adb command string to run a specific instrumentation.

methods.name: _BuildInstrumentationCommand( self, package, runner_name, no_window_animation=False, profile=False, raw_mode=True, instrumentation_args={}, user=None, no_hidden_api_checks=False)
methods.description: Builds the instrumentation command string.

methods.name: _BuildInstrumentationCommandPath( self, instrumentation_path, no_window_animation=False, profile=False, raw_mode=True, instrumentation_args={}, user=None, no_hidden_api_checks=False)
methods.description: Constructs the command path for instrumentation.

methods.name: _CreateTraceDir(self)
methods.description: Creates a trace directory on the device if it does not exist.

methods.name: WaitForDevicePm(self, wait_time=120)
methods.description: Waits for the device's package manager to be responsive.

methods.name: IsInstrumentationInstalled(self, package_name, runner_name)
methods.description: Checks if a specific instrumentation is installed on the device.

methods.name: WaitForProcess(self, name, wait_time=120)
methods.description: Waits until a process with a given name is running.

methods.name: WaitForProcessEnd(self, name, wait_time=120)
methods.description: Waits until a process with a given name is no longer running.

methods.name: _WaitForShellCommandContents(self, command, expected, wait_time, raise_abort=True, invert=False)
methods.description: Waits until a shell command output contains or does not contain a specific string.

methods.name: WaitForBootComplete(self, wait_time=120)
methods.description: Waits until the device has completed boot.

methods.name: Sync(self, retry_count=3, runtime_restart=False)
methods.description: Performs an adb sync operation, handling errors and remounts as needed.

methods.name: GetSerialNumber(self)
methods.description: Retrieves the serial number of the device.

methods.name: RuntimeReset(self, disable_keyguard=False, retry_count=3, preview_only=False)
methods.description: Performs a reset of the Android runtime without rebooting.

methods.name: PreviewShellCommand(self, cmd)
methods.description: unavailable
